title: Pre-ex-dividend run-up: regular quarterly payers in the five sessions before the ex-date
references: Hartzmark and Solomon (2013), The Dividend Month Premium, Journal of Financial Economics
Lakonishok and Vermaelen (1986), Tax-Induced Trading Around Ex-Dividend Days
Kalay (1982), The Ex-Dividend Day Behavior of Stock Prices: A Re-Examination of the Clientele Effect
Elton and Gruber (1970), Marginal Stockholder Tax Rates and the Clientele Effect
hypotheses: LONG only, over decisions 2016-08-01..2026-07-31 on the frozen 127-name research cohort (config/research/spread/cohort-v1.json): for a non-special cash dividend whose previous non-special ex-date of the same name lies 77..105 calendar days earlier and with no other corporate action for the name within 10 calendar days of the decision-to-ex span, enter at 10:35 New York five sessions before the ex-date (2 x ATR14 stop, 3R target, liquidity gate on raw bars as of the session before) and exit at the close of the last cum-dividend session unless the stop or target fills first; 5 bps per side decides. Control = the same name, same bracket and hold, decided 32 sessions after the leg's decision (mid-quarter), dropped when any ex-date of the name falls within one session of its span or a corporate action is nearby. P1: mean R_cost > 0 with the bootstrap ci90 lower bound > 0. P2: mean R_cost(leg) - mean R_cost(control) > 0 with the paired ci90 lower bound > 0, pairs keyed by the leg's decision session. P3: the 1%-trimmed mean > 0 and the mean over decisions from 2023-01-01 > 0. P4: at least 300 leg events, at least 100 from 2023-01-01. Stationary session-block bootstrap over leg decision sessions, block mean 10, 2000 draws, seed 20261012; ci90 = [5th, 95th] percentiles. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-12-exdiv-leg-design.md.
decision_rule: The leg becomes eligible for a capped live paper probe (its own spec) only if P1, P2, P3 and P4 all hold; otherwise it stays off and is recorded as failed. No threshold, lead, offset, gap band or bracket is revisited after the run; any change is a new version with a new, non-overlapping window. The secondary 10-session hold (crossing the ex-date on adjusted bars) is a descriptive diagnostic and decides nothing.
